content:
Goal: For the member whose member number is {{inputs.member_id}}, open a new sub-account of type {{inputs.account_type}} with nickname {{inputs.nickname}} and an opening deposit of {{inputs.opening_deposit}}, funded from the member's Share Savings account (suffix 00). Confirm it, then read the confirmation number and the new suffix.

Inputs (use these placeholders):
- {{inputs.member_id}}: 5-digit member number
- {{inputs.account_type}}: Type of sub-account to open
- {{inputs.nickname}}: Nickname shown on statements
- {{inputs.opening_deposit}}: Amount moved from share savings

Outputs to extract:
- confirmation_number (string): Core system confirmation, e.g. C-004512
- new_suffix (string): Suffix of the newly opened sub-account
